meta.predictive_model: predictive_score = min(100, round(residual_score * exposure_multiplier * (1 + velocity_uplift) * confidence_weight))

kpi_definitions.risk_velocity: Rate/direction of risk score change to predict emerging risk before threshold breach.
kpi_definitions.control_effectiveness: Implementation, test pass rate, and evidence coverage to compute residual risk.
kpi_definitions.detection_response: MTTD, MTTR, alert coverage, rollback time, and dry-run success to predict incident duration/recoverability.
kpi_definitions.exposure: Affected systems/records/users, sensitivity, external exposure, privilege, and autonomy tier to predict blast radius.
kpi_definitions.assurance: Eval, red-team, framework mapping, evidence freshness, and independent validation to predict assurance gaps.
kpi_definitions.leading_indicators: Category-specific early-warning signals (data drift, DQ, hallucination, injection, agent controls).
kpi_definitions.agentic_controls: Tool allowlists, approval gates, step budgets, permission scope, and loop detection for agentic risk.
kpi_definitions.governance_health: Review overdue days, owner load, RACI coverage, sign-off SLA, and audit closure to predict process failure.
kpi_definitions.compliance: Control mapping, compliance test pass rate, and regulatory-change impact to predict compliance breach likelihood.
kpi_definitions.incidents: Incidents, near-misses, repeat rate, and root-cause closure to predict recurrence.
kpi_definitions.confidence: Assessment confidence, evidence completeness, and source count to weight predictions.
kpi_definitions.dependency: Criticality, third-party SPOF, and correlated tags to predict systemic/correlated risk.
kpi_definitions.predictive: Computed exposure multiplier, velocity uplift, confidence weight, predictive score, and predictive band.

risks.name: Rollback Gap
risks.description: Harmful actions cannot be safely reverted.
